ns2:course.label: History of Jews in Diaspora
ns2:course.description: Deals with the history of the Jewish people from the destruction of the Jewish state by Rome to the reestablishment of a Jewish state in 1948. The emphasis is on the interaction between the Jewish and non-Jewish worlds as well as changes internal to the Jewish communities. Same as RLST 434. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
